style: cinematic 3D animation, slapstick physical comedy, deadpan satire
subject: ONE spotted male hyena, crumpled shirt, loose tie, bared grin, jaw working on air when silent

props.wad: one thick wad of blank money from the vulture cashier, under his arm or in a paw
props.case: one empty open briefcase in his free paw

environment: marble bank hall at noon, a tall doorway deep in the background, vultures in shirts and ties
lighting: bright white daylight, hard cyan rim left, warm amber kick right
motion_rule: The world flies at the hero: the hall and the vultures rush INTO the lens while the hyena drives across frame toward the far doorway in short lunges. A vulture crosses the lens every beat. The camera never stops, new shot size every beat, one hero action per beat, hero fills half the frame height, muzzle to the lens, medium to close.

audio.rate: 3.4 syllables per second; each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0; speech ends by 7.35
audio.lip_sync: muzzle to the lens, jaw opens on every syllable, mouth empty while speaking; only the last note enters the mouth at 7.80

timeline.action: hurls his torso across frame toward the far doorway, wad under his arm; the vulture cashier snaps its wing back into the lens, the wad just out of its claws
swings the open briefcase up on the move to drop the wad into it; a vulture rips a third of the wad away in mid air over the open case at the lens
snaps his jaw on air, head jerking sideways; a vulture sweeps into the lens tearing loose notes off the wad
throws his body a full length toward the doorway; two vultures fly at the lens, splitting apart at his muzzle
wrenches his torso left, swapping the wad to the other paw on the move; a vulture at the lens tucks a note behind its tie
swats the briefcase across frame without slowing; two vultures land on his shoulders, pecking the wad
muzzle to the lens, throws his body sideways and shakes the vultures loose; one rips off into the lens, feathers across frame
tosses the thinning wad paw to paw on the move; a vulture bursts from the depth into the lens with the next to last note

lunges muzzle front on into the lens until it fills the frame, one lone note pinched in his paw; all vultures peel off and fly from the lens into the depth, a white wedge of daylight from the doorway on his muzzle
flips the lone note into his jaws and swallows, the lump rolling down his throat, muzzle still filling the frame
jabs his empty paw at the vulture behind him, accusing it, jaw snapping on air as at 1.75; the vulture recoils into the lens, wings thrown up
shakes the empty briefcase out across frame, a paper ball flies out; a vulture snatches it at the lens and is gone

must_appear: the wad comes from the vulture cashier; jaw snapping on air at 1.75 and the same snap at 8.40; the lone note in his paw at 7.35, swallowed at 7.80; his muzzle fills the frame from 7.35 to 8.40
negative_prompt: silent opening, still last second, dangling limp paws, hero riding on anything, conveyor belt, cart, rail, view from behind, lowered head during speech, parked camera, push in, motionless background, printed words on props, digits, any letters Cyrillic or Latin, price tag, speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, night, dark scene, black bars, horizontal frame, speech after 7.35, English speech, foreign accent, extra limbs, multiple hyenas
